Conversions run keeper-built aggregator calldata: 0x (AllowanceHolder, quotes with taker = the vault) with zRouter as the fallback the keeper builds itself; the vault only calls swapTargets (vault factory setSwapTarget, owner = the Safe), approves exactly the amount in, resets it after, and checks its own balances (input down by exactly the amount, output up by at least the keeper's non-zero floor). paymentTokens (registry allowlist, at most 15 ERC-20s), swapTargets, ethPool and minContributions (vault factory) are set by the script before the ownership handoff, per docs/IMD-INFER-VAULT.md.

USDC 2 (0.0009 ETH), IMD 1 (0.0011 ETH), INFER 3,500 (0.001 ETH), imdUSD 3 (0.0008 ETH), WBTC/cbBTC 3,000 sats (0.001 ETH). Dust can't be spammed into a vault; a contribution of a new token no longer breaks a keeper call either way (subset conversion). Tokens the keeper swaps to ETH (USDC, WBTC, cbBTC) join the batch's one ETH -> IMD swap.
